title: Align product docs with shipped features and audit npm readiness
description: Update product, architecture, roadmap, README and generated agent onboarding to describe the implementation accurately. Reconcile historical research/review notes and identify any remaining work or owner decisions required before the first npm release.
why: Several documents still say MCP is unavailable or excluded and describe the old single-project UI; release readiness must be clear before npm publication.

acceptance.text: No current product document contradicts shipped MCP, multi-project serve, or optional semantic search
The CLI onboarding accurately describes available integrations
Release blockers and owner decisions are listed with evidence and no publication occurs

todos.text: Align current docs and generated onboarding with shipped integrations
Review and record the first npm release gates
Correct CI tests that assume path spelling or timestamp uniqueness
